home.paragraph.direction.more-options.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Text Options.

home.paragraph.align-text.more-options.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Text Options.

home.drawing.arrange.selection-pane.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Selection Pane (panes/selection.tsx); on while it is open.

home.editing.select.selection-pane.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Selection Pane (panes/selection.tsx); on while it is open.

home.editing.selection-pane.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Selection Pane (panes/selection.tsx); on while it is open.

shapeformat.arrange.selection-pane.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Selection Pane (panes/selection.tsx); on while it is open.

pictureformat.arrange.selection-pane.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Selection Pane (panes/selection.tsx); on while it is open.

home.drawing.outline.more-lines.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Fill & Line.

shapeformat.styles.outline.more-lines.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Fill & Line.

shapeformat.styles.fill.gradient.note: U:prism/format-tabs: Gradient opens the Format Shape pane on Fill & Line, where the gradient is edited (presets, type, direction, stops).

home.drawing.effects.format-shape.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Effects.

shapeformat.styles.effects.format-shape.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Effects.

pictureformat.styles.effects.format-shap.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Effects.

shapeformat.pane.format.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Format Shape pane (panes/format.tsx); on while it is open.

pictureformat.adjust.corrections.picture.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Picture.

pictureformat.adjust.color.picture-color.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens the Format Shape pane on Picture.

home.designer.design-ideas.note: U:prism/format-tabs: shows or hides the Design Ideas pane, the same as Design > Design Ideas.

pictureformat.adjust.color.recolor.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the recolor presets (picture.recolors) as rows with their two colours: No Recolor, Grayscale, Sepia, Washout, Black and White 25/50/75%, then each theme colour Dark and Light.

home.slides.section.collapse-all.note: U:prism/format-tabs: folds every section of the slide pane shut (view state, not undoable); not checked against upstream (deckcraft's thumbnail pane does not fold).

home.slides.section.expand-all.note: U:prism/format-tabs: opens every section of the slide pane.

shapeformat.insert.merge.note: U:prism/merge: Merge Shapes (union, combine, fragment, intersect, subtract) of the selected shapes; the result keeps the first shape's formatting (core/prism/lib/polybool.mjs). A text box with no fill and no outline merges as its box: deckcraft merges its letters, and the app has no text outlines.

playback.preview.play.note: U:prism/media: plays or pauses the clip in the editor (the player over its frame, trim, fades, volume and loop applied); nothing plays by itself outside Slide Show.

videoformat.preview.play.note: U:prism/media: plays or pauses the video in the editor.

videoformat.adjust.poster.note: U:prism/media: the picture shown before the video plays: the frame the player shows, a picture from file, or none.

home.images.picture.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the same as Insert > Pictures > This Device…: the system Open dialog picks the picture.

pictureformat.adjust.change.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the system Open dialog picks the new picture; it keeps the picture's place and size (picture.change).

record.content.video.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the system Open dialog picks a video file (insert.video); the tab never records from a camera.

record.content.audio.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the system Open dialog picks an audio file (insert.audio); the tab never records from a microphone.

record.save.save-as-show.note: U:prism/format-tabs: Save As with the PowerPoint Show type (.ppsx); the same package opens straight into the show.

record.record.cameo.note: Hidden: Cameo records the camera into the slide. Nothing upstream, and a camera is never opened without the person starting it; no engine.

record.content.screenshot.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no screenshot or screen clipping, and the app never captures the screen on its own.

record.content.screen-recording.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no screen recording. A recording would have to be started by the person with a visible recording indicator; there is no engine for it.

record.help.learn-more.note: Hidden: it only opened deckcraft's own web page (links::APP_PAGE).

insert.media.video.stock-videos.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no stock videos.

insert.media.video.online-videos.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no online videos.

insert.media.audio.record-audio.note: Hidden: deckcraft cannot record audio, and the app never opens a microphone on its own.

insert.images.pictures.stock-images.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no stock images.

insert.images.pictures.online-pictures.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no online pictures.

insert.images.screenshot.available-windo.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no screenshot; the app never captures another window.

insert.images.screenshot.screen-clipping.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no screen clipping; the app never captures the screen.

insert.symbols.equation.ink-equation.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no ink equation (its Ink to Math is a disabled 'coming soon' button).

shapeformat.insert.edit-shape.reroute-co.note: Hidden: Reroute Connectors has no upstream engine; connectors keep their glue (connect.mjs) and follow their shapes.

playback.bookmarks.add.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no media bookmarks.

playback.bookmarks.remove.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no media bookmarks.

videoformat.adjust.corrections.note: Hidden: deckcraft draws no brightness or contrast change on a video.

videoformat.adjust.color.note: Hidden: deckcraft draws no recolor on a video.

videoformat.adjust.reset.note: Hidden: deckcraft has no video corrections or recolor to reset.

record.record.from-beginning.note: U:prism/format-tabs: deckcraft's From Beginning rehearses the show (clock, slide times kept at the end); narration and camera are not recorded.

record.record.from-current.note: U:prism/format-tabs: the same from the current slide.

dialog.gridOptions.note: U:prism/format-tabs: deckcraft's Grid Options: snap to grid and to other objects, the spacing, display the grid and the drawing guides. PowerPoint's separate smart-guides display box and Set as Default have no engine (deckcraft's smart guides are the one 'Snap objects to other objects' setting), so they are not shown.

dialog.compressPictures.note: U:prism/compress: deckcraft's Compress Pictures options (apply to this picture or all, delete cropped areas, 330/220/150/96 ppi). PowerPoint's Use original resolution and Use default resolution have no engine and are not shown.

options.label: HD (330 ppi): good quality for high-definition displays
Print (220 ppi): excellent quality on most printers and screens
Web (150 ppi): good for web pages and projectors
E-mail (96 ppi): minimise document size for sharing
